Package io.telekom.orchest.telemetry.metrics

Class NoOpMetricsRecorder

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.telemetry.metrics.NoOpMetricsRecorder
All Implemented Interfaces:
MetricsRecorder
public final class NoOpMetricsRecorder extends Object implements MetricsRecorder
Recorder that discards every increment. Wired into modules that don't participate in persistent metrics collection (e.g. orchest-rest, sentinel) so engine code never has to null-check its dependency.

    • drainSnapshot

      public Map<MetricKey,Long> drainSnapshot()
      Description copied from interface: MetricsRecorder
      Atomically returns the per-key delta accumulated since the previous drainSnapshot (or since startup) and advances the high-water mark so subsequent calls report only newly accumulated work. The underlying counters are never reset.

      Implementations may return an empty map if there is no new work to flush.

      Specified by:
      drainSnapshot in interface MetricsRecorder

    • peekSnapshot

      public Map<MetricKey,Long> peekSnapshot()
      Description copied from interface: MetricsRecorder
      Returns the per-key delta currently accumulated since the previous flush without advancing the high-water mark. Intended for diagnostic endpoints.
      Specified by:
      peekSnapshot in interface MetricsRecorder

    • restore

      public void restore(Map<MetricKey,Long> deltas)
      Description copied from interface: MetricsRecorder
      Re-stages a previously drained snapshot back into the recorder. Used by the flush service to recover from a transient persistence failure without losing counts.
      Specified by:
      restore in interface MetricsRecorder
